procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial session; no agents, forks, resumes, peer reviews or maker explanations. Read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, compact method/addendum and all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing. The packet declares zero source assets and zero protected layouts, so there were no source opens or protected-manifest reads. Actually opened each exact poster with tools.view_image(detail=original), emitting the returned image to inspect it: R10-C1-M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M2 in that order; then M3; then M4; then M5. Completed those fifteen openings before the first copy-reading/transcription stage or judgment/score. After the final M5 thumbnail, read copy from the already displayed native views, in packet copy order, and used the already displayed usage720/thumbnail320 views for scale and set judgments. No ambiguity-triggered revisits or further image opens. Pins were byte-hashed; those checks and manifest reads were not treated as image viewing. Native dimensions are 1672x941 for each member: the height-side nearest-integer test is abs(941-1672*9/16)=0.5 pixels, so ratio PASS uses declared rounding rather than mathematical equality. The pinned usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180; all were viewed at their own supplied sizes. Session identity is left null for the runner.
